components.name: Node.js tls sessions on default settings (at least Node.js 22.13.0)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: These are HTTPS clients using default Node.js TLS configurations that allow ffdhe2048 (2048-bit Diffie-Hellman) which is vulnerable to quantum attacks. The weakest group permitted is ffdhe2048, making these sessions harvestable.

properties.name: pqs:context
